title: CNPC Gecko Addon CE
description: Community-maintained CNPC Gecko Addon with extended scripting APIs and multi-animation system.
body: # CNPC-Gecko-Addon-CE > Community-maintained edition of CNPC Gecko Addon. > Driven by community feedback and real production needs for CNPC creators. > CNPC Gecko Addon 社区维护版本。 > 基于社区反馈与实际制作需求持续维护与扩展。 --- ## About | 关于 CNPC Gecko Addon CE is a community-maintained continuation of the original CNPC Gecko Addon. The goal of this project is **not to replace the original addon**, but to improve usability, stability, and scripting flexibility based on community needs. It focuses on: - Production-oriented improvements - Script system usability enhancements - Stability fixes in modded environments - Maintaining compatibility with existing CNPC workflows --- CNPC Gecko Addon CE 是原 CNPC Gecko Addon 的社区维护延续版本。 本项目的目标**并非替代原版附属**，而是在保持兼容性的基础上： - 根据社区需求优化实用性 - 提升脚本系统的易用性与扩展性 - 修复复杂模组环境下的稳定性问题 - 保持与现有 CNPC 工作流兼容 --- ## Features | 功能 ### Extended Animation System | 动画系统扩展 - Attack animation menu (up to 20 animations) - Hurt animation menu (up to 20 animations) - Death animation menu (up to 20 animations) - Weighted animation selection system --- - 攻击动画菜单（最多 20 个） - 受伤动画菜单（最多 20 个） - 死亡动画菜单（最多 20 个） - 支持权重随机播放系统 ![rather](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e79503095e18fa5333892bdc1660cf294361e8ba.png) --- ### Script Model Controller | 脚本模型控制系统 Scripted items can dynamically control Gecko models at runtime. Supported features: - Model switching - Texture binding - Animation file binding - Idle animation control - Runtime animation playback - Scale / Rotation control - Inventory display adjustment (size & offset) --- 脚本载体可在运行时动态控制 Gecko 模型。 支持功能： - 模型切换 - 贴图绑定 - 动画文件绑定 - 待机动画控制 - 动画运行时播放 - 缩放 / 旋转控制 - 物品栏显示调整（大小与偏移） ![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb6a82acf694c33f56f4fb594c8fc210f3784a22.png) --- ### Stability Improvements | 稳定性优化 - Fixed Gecko model jitter during NPC loading - Fixed limb flickering in heavily modded environments - Improved animation sync stability under multi-mod setups - Fixed an issue where Gecko NPCs could become stuck in an incorrect animation state, causing abnormal model offsets and delayed idle/walk animation transitions. --- - 修复 NPC 加载 Gecko 模型时的抽搐问题 - 修复多模组环境下肢体闪回问题 - 提升多模组环境动画同步稳定性 - 修复 Gecko NPC 动画状态偶尔卡死的问题，该问题会导致模型异常平移，并造成待机/移动动画切换异常或延迟恢复。 --- ![rather](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb2726e8d7de77e05622f437611284c6a9fddd93.png) ## GitHub Issues | Issue / Feedback Have an idea, found a bug, or want to suggest improvements? Please use **GitHub Issues** as the primary feedback channel for: - Bug reports - Feature requests - Usage feedback - Improvement suggestions --- ## GitHub Issues | 问题反馈 有想法、Bug 或优化建议？ 请优先通过 **GitHub Issues** 提交，包括： - Bug 反馈 - 功能需求 - 使用问题 - 改进建议 --- You may also contact the maintainer via Bilibili dynamic or community channels: - https://space.bilibili.com/353609880/dynamic Discord is not actively monitored. --- 也可以通过 Bilibili 动态或社区渠道联系维护者： - https://space.bilibili.com/353609880/dynamic Discord 并非主要维护渠道，回复较少。 --- ## Roadmap | 开发计划 This project currently prioritizes: - Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge - Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge Future support for additional versions may be considered via community demand. Planned features: - Static OBJ model support (non-animated) --- 本项目当前优先支持： - Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge - Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge 未来是否支持更多版本将根据社区需求决定。 计划功能： - OBJ 静态模型支持（非动画） --- ## Credits | 致谢 Original project: **Goodbird** Maintained under MIT License. Special thanks to the CNPC community for feedback, testing, and suggestions. --- 原始项目：**Goodbird** 本项目基于 MIT License 维护。 感谢 CNPC 社区所有提供反馈、测试与建议的成员。 --- ## License | 许可证 MIT License.
